parameters.name: ContactDisposition
parameters.description:
Filters results by hangup type.

Valid values: Success (normal), NoAnswer (not connected), AbandonedInContactFlow (abandoned in IVR), AbandonedInQueue (abandoned in queue), AbandonedRing (abandoned while ringing), QueueOverflow (queue timeout), OneStepTransfer (transferred to external line). Separate multiple values with commas.

parameters.name: ContactId
parameters.description: The contact ID used to query the record of a specific call. You can obtain the contact ID through the softphone SDK during a call.

parameters.name: ContactType
parameters.description:
Filters results by call type.

Valid values: Inbound (inbound call), Outbound (outbound call), Back2Back (dual call), PredictiveDial (predictive dialing), PrivacyDial (virtual number outbound call). Separate multiple values with commas.

parameters.name: Criteria
parameters.description:
The search criteria.

You can search by customer phone number, agent name, or skill group name.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the call center.

parameters.name: OrderBy
parameters.description: The sort order by time. Default value: ASC. Valid values: ASC and DESC.

parameters.name: PhoneNumber
parameters.description: The phone number of the call center for which you want to retrieve data.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time of the historical data to retrieve. Default value: 0, which indicates the start of the current day (00:00).

parameters.name: StopTime
parameters.description: The end time of the historical data to retrieve. Default value: 0, which indicates the current time.

parameters.name: WithRecording
parameters.description: Specifies whether to include recordings. Default value: true. Explicitly setting this to false can speed up the query.
